    """
    Tests the recurrence g(n)+g(n+1)+840 = g(n+2)g(n+3)
    starting with g(1)=g1 and g(2)=g2.
    """
    if g1 < 2 or g2 < 2:
        return "Invalid initial conditions (must be >= 2)"

    g = [0] * (steps + 2)
    g[1] = g1
    g[2] = g2

    print(f"--- Testing initial conditions: g(1)={g1}, g(2)={g2} ---")
    print(f"g(1)={g[1]}, g(2)={g[2]}")
    
    for n in range(1, steps):
        # Calculate g[n+3]
        # g(n)+g(n+1)+840 = g(n+2)g(n+3)
        # g(n+3) = (g(n)+g(n+1)+840) / g(n+2)
        
        numerator = g[n] + g[n+1] + 840

        g[n+3] = numerator // denominator
        print(f"Step n={n}: Calculated g({n+3}) = {g[n+3]}")

    print("\nSequence successfully generated for at least 10 steps.")
    return g[1:steps+1]
